name: Indexa Capital Group, S.A.
summary: Indexa Capital Group, S.A., together with its subsidiaries, holds interests in financial and insurance companies. The company offers investment funds and asset management, and insurance brokerage services. It also provides investment fund portfolios indexed investments, individual pension plans, individual EPSV plans, and employment pension plans; life insurance; risk; interest-bearing savings accounts; retirement savings products under the Caravel brand; and indexed life insurance savings under the Indexa brand. Indexa Capital Group, S.A. was founded in 2014 and is based in Bilbao, Spain.
